methodology.selection: Sort all task candidates by input length, question index, and choice index; use eight-candidate slices centered at length quantiles 0.25, 0.50, and 0.75.

methodology.initial_state_handling: Identical precomputed per-question initial states supplied to every independent policy forward; normal CPU generation plus GPU transfer is separately timed and checked.
methodology.initial_state_storage: All three precomputed batch states remain on GPU during measurements.
methodology.output_projection: Full vocabulary at answer-predicting positions only.
methodology.order: Repetition r rotates batch order by r; batch b rotates policy order by r+b. Each call performs a separate forward.
methodology.aggregate: Sum one latency from each sampled batch per repetition, then report median, quartiles and MAD. Ratios compare policy aggregate medians.
methodology.interpretation: Sampled scoring latency; Hidden has unchanged matrix-product FLOPs but additional reference capture and vector operations.

flops_512_token_prefill.accounting_difference: The paper's printed Huginn TFLOPs match Transformer blocks and head with dense attention, excluding the recurrent 2d-to-d injection matrix. Both ledgers are retained.
flops_512_token_prefill.hidden_guidance_cost: Hidden guidance has the same matrix products as baseline and one complete coda/head. It additionally captures the reference state and blends raw recurrent states over the full sequence; these operations can affect measured latency and memory.

methodology.selection: Sort all task candidates by input length, question index, and choice index; use eight-candidate slices centered at length quantiles 0.25, 0.50, and 0.75.
methodology.scope: Independent standalone teacher-forced answer-token likelihood scoring at the same recurrent depth.
methodology.hidden_intervention: Blend full-sequence raw recurrent states before pre-coda normalization; perform one complete coda and vocabulary head.
methodology.timed_operations: Input validation, initial-state clone, embedding, prelude, recurrence, policy-specific readout and guidance, log_softmax, and target gather; perf_counter with CUDA synchronization before and after.
methodology.excluded_from_policy_timing: Checkpoint loading, tokenizer/data preparation, tensor construction/transfer, initial random-state generation/transfer, warmup, and serialization.
methodology.initial_state_handling: Identical precomputed per-question initial states supplied to every independent policy forward; normal CPU generation plus GPU transfer is separately timed and checked.
methodology.initial_state_storage: All three precomputed batch states remain on GPU during measurements.
methodology.output_projection: Full vocabulary at answer-predicting positions only.
methodology.order: Repetition r rotates batch order by r; batch b rotates policy order by r+b. Each call performs a separate forward.
methodology.aggregate: Sum one latency from each sampled batch per repetition, then report median, quartiles and MAD. Ratios compare policy aggregate medians.
methodology.interpretation: Sampled scoring latency; Hidden has unchanged matrix-product FLOPs but additional reference capture and vector operations.

source.title: Decoding Looped Transformers Better for (Almost) Free
source.metric_caveat: The paper does not unambiguously identify acc versus acc_norm for every task. The reproduction retains its pre-specified primary metrics and reports both metrics.

paper_reference.scope: Full-depth fixed LoopCD-Hidden, Huginn R16 and R32, four selected multiple-choice tasks. This is not the Table A8 R32-to-R16 setting, which uses reference h6 at R16. No adaptive Hidden policy is reported.

bootstrap.macro_ci: Independent within-task paired resampling, equal-task mean delta, percentile 95% CI.

permutation.method: Paired sign flips conditional on within-task correctness discordances; two-sided plus-one Monte Carlo p.

multiplicity.primary_tasks: Holm across 16 exact McNemar tests: four tasks × two depths × two contrasts.
multiplicity.primary_macro: Holm across four sign-flip tests: two depths × two contrasts.

statistical_protocol.secondary_views: All-acc and all-acc_norm means are descriptive. Primary inference uses only pre-specified task metrics.
statistical_protocol.limitations: Four fixed tasks and one deterministic initial-state seed; confidence intervals capture within-task question sampling, not checkpoint or initialization uncertainty.

analysis_plan.scope: Full-depth fixed-strength LoopCD-Hidden on Huginn R16 and R32 across the four existing multiple-choice tasks.
analysis_plan.primary_mean: Equal weight for each of four fixed task accuracies, computed separately at each depth.

bootstrap.method: Paired question resampling independently within fixed tasks; percentile 95% interval

permutation.method: Two-sided correctness sign flips within tasks; equal-task mean and plus-one Monte Carlo p

multiplicity.method: Separate Holm families: 2 depths x 4 tasks x 2 contrasts, and 2 depths x 2 mean contrasts

timing.description: Independent baseline, fixed Logits and Hidden policies on identical candidate batches and initial states; fixed length-quantile selection; geometric mean latency ratios across four tasks at each depth.

analysis_plan.parameter_selection: Paper Table 3(a)/A4 multiple-choice settings fixed before Hidden scoring; no task-specific tuning. All original Logits and baseline outcomes were already known.
